Technical Manual
:::

## What this page explains

The Downloads page refreshes automatically before every Quarto render. **No separate Downloads-refresh action is required.**

This page is technical reference material for maintaining or checking the catalogue builder.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="No separate refresh action"}
The `pre-render` setting in `site/_quarto.yml` runs the catalogue builder automatically. Complete the normal website render and deployment process; do not maintain `site/downloads/downloads.yml` by hand.
:::

## Files and data flow

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `site/_quarto.yml` | Runs `python scripts/build_download_catalogue.py` before every site render. Because Quarto runs from `site/`, this resolves to the repository script below. |
| `site/scripts/build_download_catalogue.py` | Finds and validates approved metric-package catalogue records, then builds the central list. It uses only the Python standard library. |
| `site/downloads/files/metrics/**/catalogue/{release_id}.yml` | Public catalogue records created by the CVD event and mortality Step 6 publication controllers. |
| Approved ZIP named by each catalogue record | Public package that must exist before its entry can be listed. |
| `site/downloads/downloads.yml` | Generated central catalogue read by the Downloads page. Never edit it manually. |
| `site/downloads/index.qmd` | Public Downloads page and Quarto listing definition. |
| `site/downloads/downloads-table.ejs.md` | Table template used to display the generated listing. |

## Accepted catalogue records

The builder currently accepts:

- `schema: bnr_download_manifest_v1`;
- `package_type: metric`;
- download items marked `include_in_listing: true`;
- public links beneath the permitted `files/` prefix; and
- ZIP files that exist at the recorded public path.

It indexes public packages only. It does not check analytical results, approve a data release, publish files, render Quarto or deploy the website.

## Automatic result

During a normal render, the builder prints:

- `Catalogue status: written` when the generated content changes; or
- `Catalogue status: unchanged` when the current file is already correct.

Both are successful results. Writing only when content changes prevents the Quarto preview from entering a live-reload loop.

## Failure protection

The builder validates every source record and selected ZIP before replacing `site/downloads/downloads.yml`. If validation fails, it prints `CATALOGUE BUILD STOPPED` and retains the existing central catalogue.

Correct the catalogue record or ZIP through the relevant Step 6 publication route, then run the normal render again. Never patch `downloads.yml` to conceal an invalid source record.

## Checks during normal website review

After the normal render, check the Downloads page as part of website review:

- the expected data release appears once;
- surveillance area, period, release date and description are correct;
- the ZIP link opens the approved public package; and
- the ZIP contains the expected approved files.
